sources.claim: Smart glasses shipments grew 167% YoY in Q1 2026 — ~2.25M units in a single quarter. IDC forecasts 13.6M units for full-year 2026 and $5.1B in revenue at an ASP of ~$376.
Samsung Galaxy Glasses launched July 22, 2026 at Galaxy Unpacked London, priced $379–$499. Runs Android XR + Google Gemini + 12MP Sony IMX681 camera at eye level.
Meta held 69.2% share of the smart glasses market in Q1 2026 (IDC). EssilorLuxottica reported 7M+ AI-glasses units sold in full-year 2025 across Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta.
Wearable AI market valued at $56.6B in 2026, projected to reach $310.6B by 2033 at a 27.8% CAGR.
Oura reached an $11B valuation from its $900M Series E in October 2025. Surpassed 5.5M rings sold; projects ~$1B revenue in 2025 and CEO cited ~$2B in 2026.
WHOOP raised $575M Series G at $10.1B valuation on March 31, 2026. 2.5M members; doubled 2025 bookings to $1B+.
Fortune Business Insights: Wearable AI market projected from $56.6B (2026) to $310.6B (2033) at 27.8% CAGR.
Google announced a 3-tier AI glasses strategy for 2026–2027: audio-only Gemini glasses → monocular display glasses → binocular mixed-reality. Partnering with Warby Parker for frames.
Business of Fashion State of Fashion 2026 report identified smart glasses as a breakthrough category; AI glasses shipments grew 167% YoY; market projected to exceed $30B by 2030.
FTC's Health Breach Notification Rule (fully implemented 2026) explicitly covers wearable manufacturers. US state biometric privacy laws in Indiana and Kentucky activated 2026.

South Korea's Basic Act on AI (effective January 2026) categorizes wearable health-monitoring devices as 'high-impact AI systems.' GDPR EUDAMED registration required from May 28, 2026 for medical wearables.
Counterpoint Research: Consumer wearables to generate more than $1 trillion in cumulative revenue between 2026 and 2032.
Meta is planning a 2026 smartwatch (internally called Malibu 2) with health tracking and Meta AI built in. Meta also developing prescription AI glasses (Ray-Ban Meta Blayzer Optics, from $499).
Apple is developing AI smart glasses (camera-equipped, targeting 2027) and camera-equipped AirPods. Bloomberg reporting from early 2026 confirmed Apple's multi-product wearable AI pipeline.
Snap Spectacles (5th gen) launched at $2,195 with full AR see-through display. XREAL Project Aura priced under $1,500. First consumer-grade full AR entries in 2026.

notes: All claims in ai-smart-glasses-trend-data.json are backed by at least one source in this file. Market size figures vary by research firm (Grand View Research: $56.6B total wearable AI; IDC: $5.1B smart glasses segment alone) — the difference reflects segment scope. Smart glasses market share figures (Meta 69.2%) are from IDC Q1 2026 data as reported across multiple trade publications.
